'''''Kiros''''' was the name of a decorative [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It featured the name "[[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]],"<ref name="Deception" /> an idyllic [[Togruta]] colony [[planet]]<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref> in the [[Expansion Region]],<ref name="Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> written in large, multi-[[color]]ed [[Aurebesh]] letters that filled the entire poster. It appeared in [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]];<ref name="Deception" /> a [[Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]],<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> the settlement [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] on the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]],<ref name="Missing">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> It also appeared on a Coruscant [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] driven by [[Jay Igno/Legends|Jay Igno]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
